files.description: Qualifacts EHI Export landing page (Sphinx-generated). Lists all three platforms (CareLogic, Credible, InSync) with links to platform-specific EHI export documentation.
CareLogic-specific EHI export documentation page. Describes Single Patient and Patient Population export processes, file types (CSV in ZIP), and links to the data dictionary XLS.

CareLogic EHI Export Data Dictionary. Single-sheet Excel workbook documenting 671 tables and 8,441 columns with table/column names, descriptions, and Oracle data types. This is the primary technical artifact describing the export format.

Qualifacts EHI Export Terms of Use (September 2024). 3-page legal document governing EHI export usage, HIPAA compliance requirements, and disclaimers. Required agreement for Patient Population Exports.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the XLS data dictionary into structured JSON. Extracts tables, columns, data types, and categorizes tables into data domains.

Full structured extraction of the data dictionary: 671 tables with 8,441 columns, each annotated with domain category, descriptions, and Oracle data types. Primary queryable artifact for downstream analysis.
Parsing statistics and domain categorization summary. Lists 42 data domains with table counts, plus tables with no columns (3) or no descriptions (5).
Documentation for the enrichment scripts: run commands, input/output files, and known parsing limitations.
SingleFile snapshot of carelogic-ehi-export.html — self-contained HTML with inlined CSS/images/fonts.
SingleFile snapshot of index.html — self-contained HTML with inlined CSS/images/fonts.
